name: Rainbow Dreams
source:
The universe of Gaea is in a state of perpetual peace as time flows by without any intervening cause, until the world's creator and goddess, Myra Orbis, decides to vacate her position in Elysium to enter the human world. 

It is modern day in our world, in a time not too distant from ours. Luka Sanguis, a traumatized, anti-social genius has his life turned upside down when a mysterious girl with unbelievable white hair appears in his room, claiming to be his wife. 

Guide Luka through the harrowing experience of dealing with Myra, school and his foster mother's disdain as he struggles to achieve his dreams.
translation:
蓋婭宇宙長久以來一直處於和平之中，時間靜靜流逝，未受任何干擾。直到世界的創造者與女神邁拉．奧比斯決定離開自己在極樂世界的位置，進入人類世界。

故事發生在人類世界的現代，一個與我們所處時代相距不遠的時期。盧卡．桑吉斯是一名有過創傷、抗拒社交的天才。當一名有著一頭奇異白髮的神祕少女出現在他房間裡，自稱是他的妻子時，他的生活徹底改變了。

引導盧卡應對邁拉、學校生活與養母的輕蔑，在這段令人心力交瘁的經歷中，努力實現自己的夢想。
